author: Starman44
body:
Minecraft Username: John_The_Potato
Reason for Ban: Hacking (flying)
Why I should be unbanned:

Please don't get me wrong here, I am not denying that I have hacked on this server. I am here to ask for a second chance.

I have been banned from Avicus for almost 4 months now. Back when I played on this server, I had a 2006 MacBook Pro that ran Minecraft at a fairly slow FPS. I got 30 on good days, and that number went WAY down if I tried to PVP anybody. This frustrated me a lot. (I think that 5 fps can frustrate just about anybody :P) One day I got curious about how I could even up my chances in DTM and I started exploring the shadowy world of hacked clients. It seemed like a good idea at the time because I could get my K/D up and have a fair chance against other players. That was wrong, and I sincerely apologize.

I have owned a server of my own for a while now. Nothing big, just vanilla survival. What I realized while I was running it was how mad it makes me when someone decides that they have the right to cheat to get what they want. It's the worst feeling in the world when I have to ban somebody who has made this wrong decision, but it helped to keep the playing field level and allowed everyone to have fun.

I have a new computer now that runs like a champ. I have tried being satisfied playing on other pvp servers but I have not found any that are quite like Avicus. It's just the awesome community where people know each other and you see people you know. You just can't get that on any server except for this one. Not to mention that this is the only server with DTM that I know of. I've cleaned up my act and started playing true vanilla Minecraft. I've found that it's more challenging that way, and that's what makes it exciting to play.

I really miss Avicus and the way it just makes you feel like you're where you belong. I miss everybody that I've met and know on this server. I am sincerely sorry for taking advantage of everyone else in my selfish ways. I hope that you can find a way to forgive me and give me one more chance. If my crimes were too severe to be pardoned, I understand. If that's the case, I have nothing to say but that I deserve it.

I miss you, Avicus.
